paragraphs.text: Dina is a dryad mage-student at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios .

Dina has a wicked sense of humor that, more often than not, edges into the darker side. She doesn’t worry or watch what she says and speaks the thoughts in her mind as they come, never giving a moment to consider whether she might be out of place with her words. Even though she is quick-witted and confident, she is attentive, making her an excellent tutor to other students. However, her teaching methods can sometimes be a little out there, like Dina herself. She knows hundreds of recipes for potions, charms, and spells that can help almost any malady, and is herself obsessed with tea.

She spends her time at Sedgemoor , the swamp , and marshlands on the college campus. She wears clothing mainly in black, green, and brown, as befits a dryad. She relies on her professors for guidance, as Dina has no family. Dina is in a relationship with Killian Lu . She usually carries a salamander -like pest with her and uses its essence to channel her magic.

When Dina was young, her glade fell victim to the insidious spread of the Brittleblight, a plague of lethargy and despair. The affliction began subtly, casting a quiet shadow of sorrow over the inhabitants. Over time, this creeping melancholy tightened its hold, gradually draining the creatures of hope and replacing their dreams with a pervasive despair. As the blight consumed their spirits, their physical forms deteriorated as well. Animals would simply lie down and never rise again, while dryads weakened, their bodies becoming fragile shells of what they once were. Despite the combined efforts of scholars throughout Arcavios to understand the origins and transmission of the disease, the source remained a mystery. Among these scholars was Dean Lisette , who arrived at Dina’s glade with the intent to save her before the blight could fully claim her. However, even Lisette’s considerable knowledge and skill were insufficient to halt the devastation of the glade itself.

As an advanced student of Strixhaven , Dina wished to revive the glade and started to research a forbidden resurrection spell. She found out that she needed the exotic root of the Esis tree as one of her ingredients. Realizing that the Esis tree was not native to Arcavios, Dina shifted her research to arcane rituals that theoretically could enable travel from one plane to another — from Arcavios to Dominaria , where Esis groves were plentiful. Without fail, these spells were almost impossible to understand, far above her ability to craft, and promised painful fates worse than death. Her search had stalled until she found a specimen in the potions classroom of Professor Onyx .

Proceeding with her experiment, Dina was drawing on the energy of a family of pests when a wayward bolt of Silverquill ink magic corrupted the process. It was thrown by Killian Lu , who was angry at being unfairly sentenced to Detention Bog by his father. The unwanted result of this coincidence was a colossal living swamp creature with a dark heart that started to destroy all living things and took off for Strixhaven as it was being lured by its magic energy. Working together, Killian and Dina managed to defeat the monster, but the Silverquill student was fatally injured. Sacrificing the last remains of the resurrection spell in her blood and the hope of resurrecting her glade, Dina cured her newfound friend. Sometime later that year, Dina was able to cure the Brittleblight, although it was too late for her grove.

When the New Phyrexian Invasion started, the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven. Professor Vess tasked a small group of surviving students - Rootha Squallheart , Quintorius Kand , Zimone Wola , Dina and Killian Lu - to search for the Invocation of the Founders in the Biblioplex. The group found it, and with a representative from each school, they could activate it, but the compleated Nassari distracted Rootha enough that Quint could only try to make up her contribution with raw magic and lifeforce. The result was not entirely successful, and in the process, Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away. Though the invocation managed to repel the main wave of attackers, the students were wounded, and Quint was missing.

Though Zimone and Dina had been friends before, they'd never collaborated on a cross-college project. Under pressure of certain death, they blended their magics and found to their delight that the intersection of Quandrix mathematics and Witherbloom biology led to new interdisciplinary magics never before seen. Using mathematical theorems, Zimone enhanced Dina's plant growth, allowing the two of them to deal exponentially more damage than they otherwise would have apart.

In the year following the Invasion, which was successfully repelled on Arcavios at large, Dina graduated from Witherbloom College. After her graduation, she enrolled in graduate school while working as a teaching assistant at the college, assisting in Professor Vess's Introduction to Magibotanical Environments class. However, in her second year as a TA, she lost four students on an excursion to a local forest, who were lured through an Omenpath by the faerie planeswalker Oko . She returned to Vess's office and asked her for help. Vess had been meeting with an old acquaintance, the planeswalker Ajani Goldmane , who offered to track the students down, as he ascertained that they were on another plane. Vess agreed, and Dina accompanied her back to campus.

As a graduate instructor, Dina led Witherbloom students Morphia , Lorenin , and Basil on a field expedition near Titan's Grave . In an effort to help the students move past the tragic death of their classmate Mertyn , Basil’s partner, Dina sought to capture a creature that preyed upon the grieving. After sheltering near a saltwater lake, Dina warned everyone against leaving with the entity alone. On separate evenings, a creature known as the Devotion sent a revenant of Mertyn to the cabin to lure one of the students to the lake. Lorenin and Morphia resisted its invitations, but Basil relented and departed with Mertyn’s apparition. The others quickly followed to assist, but Dina, remembering Professor Willowdusk ’s advice, deliberately held back to observe. As Lorenin and Morphia struggled, the Devotion seized them, and just before Dina was forced to act, Basil disabled the entity’s guiding skull with a remarkable display of magic. Hoping to help the students move past their grief and focus on their studies at Witherbloom, Dina recounted how her home grove had been destroyed by the Brittleblight and that she had cured the plague as an undergraduate. The following morning, Dina began to understand her limitations as a teacher as Basil relinquished his magical studies and returned the Devotion’s skull to the lake before walking back alone toward Titan’s Grave.
